mapper.sql: select f.referrer_id, f.referrer_type, f.display_name, f.ref_code, f.app_user_id, f.lead_id, f.status, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, (select count(*) from abr_referral r where r.referrer_id = f.referrer_id) as registered_count, (select count(*) from abr_referral r where r.referrer_id = f.referrer_id and r.status in ('valid', 'signed')) as valid_count, (select count(*) from abr_referral r where r.referrer_id = f.referrer_id and r.status = 'signed') as signed_count from abr_referrer f
mapper.select: where (false or f.lead_id = #{leadId} or f.app_user_id = #{appUserId}) order by f.referrer_id limit 1
select count(*) from abr_referrer where ref_code = #{refCode}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_referrer (referrer_type, display_name, ref_code, app_user_id, lead_id, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{referrerType}, #{displayName}, #{refCode}, #{appUserId}, #{leadId}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_referral where referrer_id = #{referrerId}
mapper.sql: select r.referral_id, r.referrer_id, f.display_name as referrer_name, f.ref_code, r.visitor_id, r.app_user_id, r.lead_id, l.display_name as lead_name, r.status, r.invalid_reason, r.valid_time, r.signed_time, r.create_time, r.update_time from abr_referral r join abr_referrer f on f.referrer_id = r.referrer_id left join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = r.lead_id
mapper.select: where r.lead_id = #{leadId} or r.visitor_id = (select visitor_id from abr_lead where lead_id = #{leadId}) order by r.referral_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_referral (referrer_id, visitor_id, app_user_id, lead_id, status, invalid_reason, create_time, update_time) values (#{referrerId}, #{visitorId}, #{appUserId}, #{leadId}, #{status}, coalesce(#{invalidReason}, ''), now(), now()) on conflict (visitor_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_referral set app_user_id = coalesce(#{appUserId}, app_user_id), lead_id = coalesce(#{leadId}, lead_id), status = #{status}, invalid_reason = coalesce(#{invalidReason}, ''), valid_time = #{validTime}, signed_time = #{signedTime}, update_time = now() where referral_id = #{referralId}
mapper.select: select channel_code as "channelCode", content_code as "contentCode", app_user_id as "appUserId" from abr_visitor where visitor_id = #{visitorId}

select visitor_id as "visitorId", cast(extract(epoch from (coalesce(submitted_time, now()) - create_time)) as bigint) as "seconds", (coalesce(flags ->> 'is_minor', 'false') = 'true' or coalesce(flags ->> 'exclude_from_referral_unlock', 'false') = 'true') as "minor" from abr_assessment where assessment_id = #{assessmentId}

with recursive chain(lead_id, merged_into, depth) as ( select lead_id, merged_into, 0 from abr_lead where lead_id = #{leadId} union all select l.lead_id, l.merged_into, c.depth + 1 from abr_lead l join chain c on l.lead_id = c.merged_into where c.depth < 10 ) select l.lead_id as "leadId", l.visitor_id as "visitorId", l.app_user_id as "appUserId", l.stage as "stage", l.display_name as "displayName", l.owner_user_id as "ownerUserId" from chain c join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = c.lead_id where c.merged_into is null limit 1
select count(*) from abr_reward where referrer_id = #{referrerId} and reward_type = 'referral' and dedup_key like concat('%:', #{milestone}, ':referrer') and create_time >= #{since}

select rule_id, referrer_type, milestone, reward_title, reward_product, referee_title, daily_cap, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_referral_rule order by referrer_type, milestone

select rule_id, referrer_type, milestone, reward_title, reward_product, referee_title, daily_cap, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_referral_rule where referrer_type = #{referrerType} and milestone = #{milestone} and status = '0'
mapper.update: update abr_referral_rule set reward_title = coalesce(#{rewardTitle}, ''), reward_product = coalesce(#{rewardProduct}, ''), referee_title = coalesce(#{refereeTitle}, ''), daily_cap = #{dailyCap}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where rule_id = #{ruleId}
